_comment: Tribes v2 economy + rules. Every knob here is editable live by admins (@Joeldan) via the in-app Elders' Forge panel, or by hand. Loyalty = the TRIBE's shared pool (primary). Kindle Score = a member's effort/activeness (sets in-tribe rank, feeds the tribe). Ember = minor personal token. Store is cosmetic/convenience ONLY, never touches Loyalty/rank/allocation.

fire.name: Age of First Fire
fire.tagline: The tribes gather around the first flame.

frost.name: The Long Frost
frost.tagline: The fires dim. Only the loyal survive the cold.

kindle._comment: Kindle Score = a member's contribution/activeness. Sets in-tribe rank and how much they feed tribe Loyalty.

loyalty._comment: Tribe shared pool. Members feed it; Ashfall bleeds it when the tribe goes quiet.

ashfall._comment: Loyalty decay. active<=1d, cooling 2-3d, fading >=4d idle. Daily bleed grows with the fading ratio and COMPOUNDS via chill the longer neglect lasts.

rekindle._comment: Save a Fading kin with Stars. Halts their decay, restores Loyalty, and earns the savior Kindle + a 'Kindred Flame' badge.

referral._comment: Bloodline: your referral tree. A joined referral boosts your Kindle and the tribe.

invasion._comment: Lands grant a daily Loyalty bonus + Embertide + a claimable relic-node (future NFT). Hold by staking Embertide; invade by out-staking during the contest window.

tasks.title: Tend the Campfire
tasks.hint: Check in daily to keep your fire alive

tasks.hint: Link a wallet to claim your share

store._comment: Telegram Stars (XTR). COSMETIC / CONVENIENCE / SOCIAL ONLY. Never grants Loyalty, Kindle, rank, land or allocation.
